poster:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished vertical 2:3 game Store poster BACKGROUND with NO TEXT, for Korean game Lightbearers.
References: image 1 = exact Lumen identity and pixel anatomy; image 2 = actual menu fortress architecture, palette, squared four-sided walls and tall slender beacon; image 3 = existing app icon, lighthouse lantern-room design; image 4 = wallhand ogre anatomy; image 5 = actual game wall-top camera and soldiers. Preserve their specific design; do not make a generic castle or realistic fantasy painting.
Composition: 2:3 portrait. Top 0-24% is nearly black ink-navy sky left open for later title. Beacon lantern room at x62% y31%, conical slate roof, tall narrow grey stone shaft, ONE warm amber beam cutting rightward into BLACK fog. Hero Lumen stands on broad blue-grey stone battlement at x39%, head y40%, feet y63%; entire small sturdy body ABOVE 65%. Silver tousled hair, big head ~1/3 body, clear blue irises and white highlights, visible tiny mouth, black cadet coat with gold edging, dark short cloak, brown big boots. Three-quarter front view, one hand holds a SMALL metal lantern at waist with warm light, other hand relaxed, simple covered fingers. Two much smaller navy-uniform archers behind him, no UI. Enemies below wall visible as subdued tiny goblin silhouettes and ONE long-armed iron-gloved ogre at far right y59%, no gore. Bottom third y67-100% is intentionally nonessential dark rough stone wall descending into black fog, no hero, no important enemy, no logo.
Style: exquisite crisp HD-2D pixel art consistent with supplied sprites, deliberately chunky square pixel clusters, thick dark one-logical-pixel character outline, ~three shade clusters per material, short bodies, big boots, sharp masonry planes, strong cast shadows from beacon, muted slate blue / charcoal / dull olive / amber gold. Asymmetric grounded composition. No smooth painted rendering, no smooth airbrush gradients, no plastic, no purple teal neon, no decorative filigree, no washed-out mist, no extra fingers, no title, letters, watermark or interface. Artwork must look like this specific game's cover.

The distinctive long-armed iron-gloved ogre may be a SMALL dark silhouette in right midground around y59% instead. Bottom third must be nonessential blank shadowed stone/fog, no faces, bright weapons or glowing lamps. Preserve nearly black navy blank sky at top for later title. NO text. No painterly smoothness. Preserve crisp clustered square pixels, dark outline and restrained night.

super_hero:

Compose a wide elevated three-quarter view of the REAL simple square grey-stone frontier fortress at NIGHT, enclosed by four straight battlement walls, low red-roof service buildings and one slender round beacon tower in centre. NOT a huge medieval fairy city, not multiple beacon spires. KEY detail concentrates in centre x30-70%, y22-62%: fortress courtyard, square walls, beacon lantern room with conical slate roof and ONE powerful warm amber beam cutting diagonally right into BLACK fog. Beam has sharply stepped pixel edges and restrained falloff, not a pale mist wash. Small silver-haired black-and-gold cadet Lumen with his small lamp stands on nearest wall with navy-clad brown-haired soldiers. Hero ~73 logical pixels tall in an intended 960x540 logical canvas, big head about 24 pixels, short sturdy body and large boots, clear blue eyes, tiny visible mouth, dark outline. Supporting figures may be smaller with distance. The architecture and lighting should resemble reference1, and terrain geometry reflect reference2. Horde approaches ALL FOUR SIDES: little dark goblins in four loose approach streams outside the north, east, south and west walls. A larger muted olive long-armed iron-gloved ogre silhouette on one flank; creatures never replace the central fortress. Hordes are readable silhouettes, not foreground portraits. Do not arrange in perfectly mirrored symmetry.

Style exact chunky HD-2D pixel art of supplied game: visible square clusters at consistent scale, thick dark 1-logical-pixel sprite outline, ~3 shade steps per material, crisp matte masonry and slate, warm beacon highlights and coherent long cast shadows. Palette charcoal, muted slate navy/grey, restrained olive, brown leather, warm gold. Dark readable night NOT grey fog. No extra torches everywhere, no sky stars decoration, no polished plastic, no painterly airbrush gradients, no neon purple/teal, no ornate fantasy clutter, no text/title/logo/UI/watermark, no gore, no weapons pointed toward viewer. An atmospheric but game-specific pixel-art fortress-defense composition.
